definitions.gloss: sudden memory lapse; momentary forgetting; mental blank
definitions.explanation: The experience of suddenly being unable to recall something you normally know well. A temporary lapse rather than genuine forgetting.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{度忘|どわす}れしてしまった。
examples.english: I had a sudden lapse and forgot the name.

examples.japanese: パスワードを{度忘|どわす}れして、ログインできない。
examples.english: I've blanked on my password and can't log in.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}をとると{度忘|どわす}れが{増|ふ}えるが、{誰|だれ}にでもあることだ。
examples.english: Memory lapses increase with age, but it happens to everyone.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used as a suru verb: {度忘|どわす}れする. Describes a temporary blank, not permanent memory loss. The word implies you normally know the information but it has momentarily slipped your mind.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {度忘|どわす}れする (to have a sudden lapse)
- {度忘|どわす}れが{増|ふ}える (memory lapses increase)
- うっかり{度忘|どわす}れする (to absentmindedly forget)
